utcOffset.description: Offset of the current timezone relative to UTC, in hours

securityLevel.description: A Security Level represents a hierarchical node of access.

name.description: The name for this security level. Unique amongst its siblings.

children.description: Security levels which descend from this security level.

id.description: A string identifier unique to this session

host.description: Remote host of the app or browser, as detected by the gateway

locale.description: The current locale of this session

lastActivity.description: Gateway date of the last user activity in the Client. Readonly.

auth.description: Represents the user's authentication and authorization status for this session.

authenticated.description: true if the user is authenticated. false if the user is not authenticated. null if the user's authentication status is unknown.

user.description: Contains information about the user if they are authenticated

id.description: The Identity Provider's unique identifier for this user. null if the user is not authenticated.

userName.description: The user's username. null if the user is not authenticated.

firstName.description: The user's first name. null if the user is not authenticated or if the Identity Provider did not provide this attribute or if no mapping was configured for this attribute.

lastName.description: The user's last name. null if the user is not authenticated or if the Identity Provider did not provide this attribute or if no mapping was configured for this attribute.

email.description: The user's email address. null if the user is not authenticated or if the Identity Provider did not provide this attribute or if no mapping was configured for this attribute.

roles.description: The roles that the Identity Provider assigned this user. null if the user is not authenticated or if the Identity Provider did not provide this attribute or if no mapping was configured for this attribute.

items.description: The name which uniquely identifies this role

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the current user last logged into Perspective from the IdP. null if the user is not authenticated.

address.description: Remote host address of the connected gateway.

type.description: Type of device that created this session. Readonly. Options: 'ios', 'android', 'designer', 'browser', 'workstation'.  Empty string if device unknown/during loading.

identifier.description: A unique ID representing the device. Readonly. Convenience property not intended/suitable for security purposes.  May change via device/application reinstalls, browser cache clears.

userAgent.description: User Agent string of the connected device.

pullToRefresh.description: If true, swiping down from top of page and holding for two seconds will refresh project.

preventSleep.description: Prevent the device from sleeping while viewing project.

accelerometer.description: When continuous read mode is active, represents values retrieved from the accelerometer.

timestamp.description: Timestamp represented as standard 'milliseconds since unix epoch'.

x.description: Acceleration force (in m/s²) along the x axis (including gravity).

y.description: Acceleration force (in m/s²) along the y axis (including gravity).

z.description: Acceleration force (in m/s²) along the z axis (including gravity).

bluetooth.description: Options and data provided by device Bluetooth services.

enabled.description: If true, will start listening for Bluetooth advertising packets.

updateInterval.description: Duration in ms to buffer Bluetooth data before sending to Perspective.

limit.description: Maximum number of packets to display. Packets with stronger RSSI have priority.

minimumRSSI.description: Minimum strength of RSSI to return, 0 to ignore.

uuid.description: 16 byte proximity uuid of iBeacon. On iOS this must be specified in order to receive iBeacon data.

data.description: Most recent packets seen by device.

geolocation.description: Options and data provided by web or native device geolocation services.

enabled.description: If true, will attempt to populate location data into the 'data' property

permissionGranted.description: If geolocation is enabled and a geolocation permission prompt is requested, this field populates true if the user allowed permission.  Otherwise, false.  Readonly.

accuracy.description: Indicates the mode of accuracy the application uses to receive results. MAX: Maximum accuracy (and highest system battery use).  Accurate to the level allowed by the environment/device.  HIGH: High accuracy (and high system battery use). accuracy resolves ~3m using a more efficient poll rate.  BALANCED: Balanced accuracy - accuracy resolves ~100m (about a city block) using a more efficient poll rate and supplementing with device data. LOW: Low accuracy - typically does not use GPS sensor, but relies on environmental meta data (such as cell tower information, wifi connectivity, etc).  Most efficient, accurate to approximately town/3 kilometers. The default value is balanced.

timeout.description: Is a positive long value representing the maximum length of time (in milliseconds) the device is allowed to take in order to return a position. The default value is Infinity, meaning that getCurrentPosition() won't return until the position is available.

maximumAge.description: Is a positive long value indicating the maximum age in milliseconds of a possible cached position that is acceptable to return. If set to 0, it means that the device cannot use a cached position and must attempt to retrieve the real current position. If set to Infinity the device must return a cached position regardless of its age. Default: 0.

data.description: If geolocation is enabled and the device can provide geolocation data, this will hold information about location.

latitude.description: A floating point value representing the position's latitude in decimal degrees.  null if location disabled.

longitude.description: A floating point value representing the position's longitude in decimal degrees. null if location disabled.

altitude.description: A double representing the position's altitude in meters, relative to sea level. This value can be null if the implementation cannot provide the data.

accuracy.description: A double representing the accuracy of the latitude and longitude properties, expressed in meters.

altitudeAccuracy.description: A double representing the accuracy of the altitude expressed in meters. May be null if device fails to provide, or geolocation is disabled.

heading.description: Returns a double representing the direction in which the device is traveling. This value, specified in degrees, indicates how far off from heading true north the device is. 0 degrees represents true north, and the direction is determined clockwise (which means that east is 90 degrees and west is 270 degrees). If speed is 0, heading is NaN. If the device is unable to provide heading information, this value is null.

speed.description: Returns a double representing the velocity of the device in meters per second. This value can be null.

timestamp.description: Time the last location update was received.

appBar.description: Settings relevant to the bottom-docked "App Bar", which lists gateway information.

togglePosition.description: The position of the overlaid toggle button that shows the app bar.

show.description: Deprecated. About panel will be shown automatically.

icon.description: The path of the about button icon.

path.description: Path of the view to display in the about modal.

title.description: The title of the about modal.

autoAppearance.description: The appearance to use for Piping with appearance prop set to auto.

overlapGap.description: The width of the gap to draw when P&ID pipes overlap.

autoAnimationSpeed.description: The speed of animations as a percent to use for Symbols with animationSpeed set to auto. 0 turns off animations.

autoAppearance.description: The appearance to use for Symbols with appearance prop set to auto.

capable.description: True if the project has been configured to work offline.

enabled.description: True if the current session was started offline, and continues to be offline.

lastSynced.description: The last time this project was synchronized for offline use.
